meta.name: fix
meta.description: Meta-skill workflow orchestrator for bug investigation and resolution. Routes to debug, implement, test, and commit based on scope.

copy.tagline: 自动排查并修复代码缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要定位和修复代码中的问题
copy.tagline_en: Automatically investigate and fix code defects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to locate and fix issues in code

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你完成一系列问题，自动调查并修复代码中的错误、依赖问题或 PR 评论。它会生成诊断报告，在实施前请求确认，并可选择添加回归测试和提交代码。
howto.when: 当你输入 /fix 命令并指定范围（如 bug、hook、deps、pr-comments）时触发。如果只输入 /fix 不带参数，Claude 会通过提问引导你选择修复类型。

say.text: /fix bug 登录按钮在 Safari 上无响应
say.note: Claude 会调查并修复该 bug。
Claude 只诊断依赖问题，不修改代码。
Claude 会获取 PR 评论并制定修复计划。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through a series of questions, automatically investigate and fix code bugs, dependency issues, or PR comments. It generates a diagnosis report, asks for confirmation before implementation, and can optionally add regression tests and commit changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type the /fix command with a scope (e.g., bug, hook, deps, pr-comments). If you type /fix without arguments, Claude will ask questions to determine the fix type.

say_en.text: /fix bug Login button not responding on Safari
say_en.note: Claude will investigate and fix the bug.
Claude will diagnose dependency issues only, no code changes.
Claude will fetch PR comments and create a fix plan.
